---
applyTo: "dreamder/**"
---
Files under `dreamder/` belong to a native macOS Swift editor, separate from the IntelliJ sources. Before changing them, read `dreamder/AGENTS.md` and follow its commands, definition of done, and non-negotiables. Its "Read first" table routes each task to the binding sections of `dreamder/docs/architecture.md`, `dreamder/docs/testing.md`, and `dreamder/docs/ui.md`; read those before starting.
